profile.headline: Appian Certified Lead Developer
profile.summary:
I am an experienced software engineer and web developer, most recently focusing on Appian, SQL, and REST APIs. Earlier experience includes JavaScript, React, Node, Express, CSS3, HTML5, and a variety of frameworks including Bootstrap and jQuery. I'm a quick learner, patient teacher, and problem solver.

My love of coding started early, styling LiveJournal layouts in the early 2000s. In 2018, I worked my way through Penn LPS Coding Boot Camp to further develop my coding skills. Now, I am a software engineer with a passion for scalable solutions.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Envision, design, and implement software solutions primarily using Appian and SQL. Collaborate on a development team using Agile Methodology and Jira.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Perform analysis, design, development, testing, debugging, and implementation of software applications and APIs primarily using Appian and Microsoft SQL Server. Work on a development team using Agile Methodology and Jira.

Key accomplishments include obtaining Appian A-Score Level 1 Credential, enhancing front-end API error-handling, developing a planning poker story pointing application, and creating JavaScript webscraping solutions for exporting Appian system information.

positions.title: Instructional Staff - Penn LPS Coding Boot Camp
positions.description: As a part of the instructional team at the Penn LPS Coding Bootcamp, I teach students MERN-stack web development skills. Technologies include JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Node.js, React.js, Git, Mongo, and MySQL. Specific responsibilities include tutoring students, assisting students with code activities and projects, researching and answering student questions, and ensuring smooth classroom activity transition.

positions.title: Office Manager
positions.description:
Key accomplishments include streamlining file and data tracking for 16 employees and 60 students by creating dynamic Excel spreadsheets, and increasing student enrollment by 20% within my first year of being Office Manager.

I completed weekly payroll and schedules for a team of 16 employees, wrote and designed a weekly email newsletter, coordinated community events, troubleshooted problems with and repaired office equipment, edited marketing materials for publishing, and ran the front desk daily.

I provided top quality assistance in maintaining a Keystone STAR 4 and NAEYC accredited child care program. I adhered to all parameters of Pennsylvania DHS requirements in addition to NAEYC and Keystone Stars values.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
Key accomplishments include providing WordPress and Outlook training to our sister sites, raising over $4000 through fundraising efforts, and finding errors and editing agreement documents and handbooks.

I provided top quality assistance in maintaining a Keystone STAR 4 and NAEYC accredited child care program. I adhered to all parameters of Pennsylvania DHS requirements in addition to NAEYC and Keystone Stars values.

As the Administrative Assistant, I maintained student and employee files, processed invoices, hosted tours for prospective parents, ran fundraisers, and maintained correspondence with parents and central administration. I designed and edited a weekly newsletter for our parents and kept our event calendar updated and full of activities. I maintained payroll for a team of 14 employees and maintained our office and school supply inventory. I also provided WordPress and Outlook training to other centers.

As the temporary PR and Marketing Associate, I excelled in writing and editing materials for publishing. These included parent handbooks, agreements, and "Caring For Kids," a newsletter sent to patrons of FELS' operations.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
Key accomplishments include increasing the store's audit score by 7% and significantly minimizing store damage losses by maintaining the "Sold As-Is" program.

I maintained store funds and payroll records, bookkept, facilitated direct UPS shipments, prepared daily bank deposits, prepared forms and reports, updated product prices, and searched databases and POS software to investigate money discrepancies. I worked with the HR department to ensure all employee paperwork was up-to-date and verifiable.

positions.title: Replenishment Associate
positions.description: Identified and adjusted inventory discrepancies using RF scanners, set planograms, and stocked retail products. Experience training new-hires.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant and Front-End Supervisor
positions.description:
Audited store funds, investigated money discrepancies, prepared the daily deposit, requested change orders from the bank, organized and filed paperwork, directed phone calls, recorded finances, ordered office supplies, facilitated direct UPS shipments, and adjusted product prices.

Handled store refunds and customer service calls, provided friendly, attentive customer service, and monitored cashier performace.

positions.title: Events Coordinator
positions.description: I coordinated and hosted over 30 in-store events for both children and adults, taught craft classes, demonstrated company products, designed promotional signs, and worked directly with customers to help plan their own craft events. I also helped roll out our new birthday party program by creating posters and promotional samples.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Assisted customers with finding products and answered their questions, familiarized myself with company products, organized and kept the store clean, operated the cash register, and provided excellent customer service.

honors.title: Michaels LP Hero (Helping Everyone and Reducing Opportunity)
honors.description: I received this reward for my accurate work during inventory management, which significantly reduced theft opportunities.
honors.issuer: Issued by Michaels Arts and Crafts · Aug 2013

honors.title: Prince William Regional Scholarship for Academic Achievement
honors.description: I was selected by the Scholarship Committee to receive a $1,300 scholarship toward my tuition at Northern Virginia Community College. My receipt of the scholarship was based on my future plans, my academic record, and my involvement in the community.
honors.issuer: Issued by Prince William Regional Chamber of Commerce · Apr 2008

volunteerExperiences.description: I planned and hosted various events at MAGStock, an annual outdoor music and gaming festival in June.

I volunteered to be the team captain for the annual Michaels Wellness Challenge, where every employee wears a pedometer and competes as a store to be the most active out of any other store in the district. As the team captain, I motivated my coworkers, created marketing materials to promote the challenge, and encouraged all team members to participate. Ultimately our team came in 3rd place out of the 15 stores in our district.
